proves.claim: addBlock stores a named block of two open items and listBlocks returns it with its members.

store.blocks.add-and-list.why: The block slice of #2202 needs a stored record before any command or claim can use it.

proves.claim: addBlock refuses a repeated name with BLOCK_EXISTS, an unknown member with NO_ITEM and a board below BLOCK_ENGINE with ENGINE_VERSION.

store.blocks.refusals.why: A block name is unique, its members exist and an older engine must not record it.

proves.claim: addBlock called through the store front door records a block that listBlocks reads.

store.blocks.real-path.why: The operation must be reachable from the store index, not only its module.
